stations.title: Choose a start and end station

body.desktop: Pick the two stops you want to travel between in the bar above, and this page will show travel times, headways and dwells for that trip.
body.mobile: Pick the two stops you want to travel between in the panel at the bottom of the screen, and this page will show travel times, headways and dwells for that trip.

body.desktop: Pick a start and end date in the bar above to see how this trip performed over time.
body.mobile: Pick a start and end date in the panel at the bottom of the screen to see how this trip performed over time.

body.desktop: Pick a date in the bar above to see every trip that ran between these two stations.
body.mobile: Pick a date in the panel at the bottom of the screen to see every trip that ran between these two stations.
